einzeiler: Test your trivia knowledge with four quiz rounds, a geography bang bang, and banana facts.
kurzfassung: David and Annie Flora present a pub trivia challenge featuring four rounds on topics ranging from television and geography to history and comics. The episode includes a geographical bang bang round on the Great Basin, a final big bang puzzle connecting San Francisco, and listener-submitted facts about the history of bananas. Sponsored by LearnClash, the show tests general knowledge across a wide variety of subjects.
stichpunkte: Four rounds of trivia questions covering television, geography, history, comics, animals, music, literature, sports, science, society, space, food, games, religion, and theater
A geography bang bang round on the eight states included in the Great Basin according to the National Park Service
A big bang final round tying together Full House, Mrs. Doubtfire, and The Joy Luck Club through the city of San Francisco
Detailed listener responses regarding the history of the Gros Michel banana and its replacement by the Cavendish variety
Discussion of artificial banana flavoring mimicking the taste of the historical Gros Michel banana rather than modern commercial bananas
A sponsored segment highlighting LearnClash for custom-topic 1v1 trivia duels and spaced repetition learning

A new week means new questions! Hope you have fun with these!
What comedienne ended her weekly shows by tugging on her left earlobe?
Which Wisconsin peninsula is nicknamed the "Cape Cod of the Midwest." It has 300 miles of shoreline and more lighthouses than any other county in the U.S.?
William the Conqueror is most famous for conquering what?
Also known for his role on MASH, who played Charlie Brown in a 1967 Off-Broadway musical "You're a Good Man, Charlie Brown"?
What is it called when fish fertilize externally?
The 1973 movie, Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid starred what two music idols?
The Ana and Din or Shadow of the Leviathan series which include "A Trade of Blood", "A Drop of Corruption", and the Hugo Award winning "The Tainted Cup" are all by what author?
Iten has been described as the Mecca of Long Distance Running and is located in what country?
Who is considered the father of modern chemistry?
Along with a cash prize, what do contestants win in the Nathan's Famous International Hot Dog Eating Contest?
Mare Imbrium, or the Sea of Showers or Sea of Rains, is a lava plain within the Imbrium Basin located where?
What flavor was the original creme filling of Twinkies?
Which composer has won the most Tony Awards?
Which board game that won the Spiel des Jahres in 2014 has you collect precious jewels and gems like Emeralds, sapphires, rubies and diamonds?
Ahura Mazda is the main deity of which religion?
Which Greek goddess of love and beauty was said to be born from seafoam?
